svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a requirement whose beats were harvested with their layout skeletons; beat 1: its schematic derives → it is drawn from the app's own measured layout — the page's real structure at the viewport it was measured in, with the focused element's own text where a beat ringed one; beat 2: no layout was ever harvested for it → it falls back to the archetype drawing, or to the labelled beats under an honest "no schematic drawn yet" — never a guessed picture
